events.title: Glycerius proclaimed Western Roman Emperor
events.description: Backed by the Burgundian general Gundobad, the court official Glycerius was proclaimed emperor at Ravenna. Deposed the next year, he was one of the short-lived final rulers of the Western Empire.
events.html: Backed by the Burgundian general Gundobad, the court official Glycerius was proclaimed emperor at Ravenna. Deposed the next year, he was one of the short-lived final rulers of the Western Empire.

events.title: Teatro Olimpico opens in Vicenza
events.description: Andrea Palladio's theatre opened with a performance of Sophocles's 'Oedipus Rex'. Its permanent painted street scenes survive, making it the oldest surviving enclosed theatre in the world.
events.html: Andrea Palladio's theatre opened with a performance of Sophocles's 'Oedipus Rex'. Its permanent painted street scenes survive, making it the oldest surviving enclosed theatre in the world.

events.title: Continental Marines land at Nassau in the Bahamas
events.description: In their first amphibious operation, American marines and sailors captured two British forts on New Providence island, seizing cannon and military stores.
events.html: In their first amphibious operation, American marines and sailors captured two British forts on New Providence island, seizing cannon and military stores.

events.title: Florida becomes the 27th US state
events.description: Florida, acquired from Spain in 1819, was admitted to the Union as a slave state. It seceded in 1861 and is now the third most populous state.
events.html: Florida, acquired from Spain in 1819, was admitted to the Union as a slave state. It seceded in 1861 and is now the third most populous state.

events.title: Lajos Kossuth demands constitutional reform for Hungary
events.description: In the Hungarian Diet at Pressburg, Kossuth called for a responsible government and constitutional rule. His speech, made as revolution swept Europe, helped launch the Hungarian revolution of 1848.
events.html: In the Hungarian Diet at Pressburg, Kossuth called for a responsible government and constitutional rule. His speech, made as revolution swept Europe, helped launch the Hungarian revolution of 1848.

events.title: Treaty of San Stefano creates a 'Greater Bulgaria'
events.description: Ending the Russo-Turkish War, the treaty created a large autonomous Bulgaria. The other great powers revised it at the Congress of Berlin that summer, leaving lasting Balkan grievances.
events.html: Ending the Russo-Turkish War, the treaty created a large autonomous Bulgaria. The other great powers revised it at the Congress of Berlin that summer, leaving lasting Balkan grievances.

events.title: Soviet Russia signs the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk
events.description: The Bolsheviks made peace with the Central Powers, giving up Poland, the Baltic lands and Ukraine, with about a third of the old empire's population. Germany's defeat later voided the treaty.
events.html: The Bolsheviks made peace with the Central Powers, giving up Poland, the Baltic lands and Ukraine, with about a third of the old empire's population. Germany's defeat later voided the treaty.

events.title: Time magazine publishes its first issue
events.description: Founded by Henry Luce and Briton Hadden, Time summarised the week's news in a brisk, distinctive style. It became one of the most influential magazines in the world.
events.html: Founded by Henry Luce and Briton Hadden, Time summarised the week's news in a brisk, distinctive style. It became one of the most influential magazines in the world.

events.title: Rodney King's beating by Los Angeles police is filmed
events.description: A bystander videotaped officers beating Rodney King after a car chase. The officers' acquittal in April 1992 sparked riots in Los Angeles in which more than 60 people died.
events.html: A bystander videotaped officers beating Rodney King after a car chase. The officers' acquittal in April 1992 sparked riots in Los Angeles in which more than 60 people died.
